input.overview: Target Pool and add-a-ball Mini Pool reward upper-playfield number collection. Plunge lanes 6, 7, and 8 to light the center bumper, then keep shooting up top so slings and bumper kicks collect the side numbers. On Target Pool, stop at 14 of 15 when Special scores zero; on Mini Pool, completing 1–10 lights both WOW lanes and can add a ball.
input.simpleOverview: In Target Pool or Mini Pool, collect top lanes 6, 7, and 8 to light the center bumper, then keep sending the ball up top so rebounds collect pool-ball numbers. Shoot center arrows only when lit. On Target Pool, leave one number uncollected if Special is worth zero; on Mini Pool, complete 1–10 and take a lit WOW for another ball when enabled.
input.summary: Use the skill shot to secure 6, 7, and 8 across different balls, then let upper rebounds build the number set. Lit center arrows are valuable but the outside and middle arrows can drain; shoot them only from control and only when their award matters.

quickInfo.name: Light the bumper
quickInfo.summary: Collect top lanes 6, 7, and 8; plan a different skill shot on each ball.

quickInfo.name: Collect numbers
quickInfo.summary: Upper slings, bumper kicks, and bank shots score the side number targets.

quickInfo.name: Target Pool boundary
quickInfo.summary: At 14 of 15 numbers, avoid finishing the set when Special converts to zero points.

quickInfo.name: Mini Pool boundary
quickInfo.summary: Completing 1–10 lights both WOW lanes and can add a ball; a drain resets the sequence and lights.

steps.text: Plunge lane 6 first, lane 8 on another ball, and lane 7 last so the newly lit bumper scores immediately.
Shoot up the sides and use push nudges above the center bank to collect unlit number targets.
After most numbers are collected, shoot only the safely reachable lit arrows for their higher value.
On Target Pool, stop one number short when Special is worthless and continue upper-playfield scoring.
On Mini Pool, complete 1–10 and collect a lit WOW before the drain resets the sequence.

buildsToward.title: A lit bumper and valuable center arrows

steps.text: Shoot up either side and nudge upper rebounds across the unlit number targets.
Cash safe lit arrows or the Mini Pool WOW award without crossing the variant boundary.

techniques.name: Dead bounce
techniques.instruction: Let a controlled inlane feed rebound across when it safely reaches the flipper that can shoot a lit arrow.

machineSetup: Identify Target Pool versus add-a-ball Mini Pool and confirm the number set, lit-arrow values, Special conversion, WOW award, and whether additional balls remain enabled.
Test all numbered targets and lamps, top lanes 6–8, center bumper lamp and value, every arrow target, both WOW lanes on Mini Pool, sequence reset, slings, and upper-playfield feeds.
